races.paceDynamic: Josh's Joy will set the pace from the front with minimal pressure in this 16-runner handicap, creating a sustainable tempo that allows the field to stay bunched. Glory To Be, Reimagined, Staysound Susie, Varshini and several other prominent runners will track within striking distance, while the hold-up horses Nancy J, Oh Cecelia, Rion Rubette and Goofy Gander will be patient at the back. The lack of genuine pace pressure means the race will develop into a sprint finish with the field tightly packed turning for home. This setup strongly favours prominent runners and those with tactical speed - the steady pace will allow handy horses to kick clear before the hold-up brigade can get into gear.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Josh's Joy sets uncontested fractions and the pace stays steady throughout
scenarios.body: The lack of pressure allows prominent runners to travel comfortably and strike first when the sprint develops. Hold-up horses find themselves with too much ground to make up when the race quickens.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Kick Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is even steadier than expected and the field stays tightly bunched
scenarios.body: The sprint finish becomes a pure test of acceleration from the back, suiting horses with the best turn of foot. Nancy J and Oh Cecelia get the perfect setup for their closing kicks.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Josh's Joy Wires Field
scenarios.trigger: If Josh's Joy gets completely uncontested lead and kicks clear approaching the furlong pole
scenarios.body: The favourite maintains his advantage to the line as the field realizes too late that the pace was genuine. Gavin Ryan's 173-day break timing pays off perfectly.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If multiple prominent runners go too slow and create a crawling pace
scenarios.body: The race becomes a complete lottery with any horse capable of winning from any position. Form and ratings become largely irrelevant in a bunch finish.

races.paceDynamic: Totally Puzzled will lead from the start with her prominent style, setting a sustainable pace without early pressure in this 11-runner maiden. The bulk of the field comprises hold-up horses (Chasing Paradise, Music And Song, Nathema, Sofi's Gift, Chablis Rock, Arizona Star) who will settle behind the modest early gallop. With soft ground adding stamina emphasis over 1m2f, the pace will likely be steady rather than strong, allowing the field to stay compact entering the straight. This setup moderately favours hold-up horses with tactical speed — the steady pace keeps them in touch, while the soft ground and step up in trip should expose any lack of stamina in the early leaders.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate finish
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays modest and the field remains compact turning for home
scenarios.body: The soft ground emphasizes stamina over speed, allowing patient riders to time their challenges perfectly. Hold-up specialists with proven form like Chasing Paradise and Chablis Rock can exploit their tactical advantages in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Lightly-raced improver strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the unexposed fillies shows significant improvement from their debut
scenarios.body: The three OR-120 newcomers have untapped potential that debut runs rarely reveal fully. Mistress Of Tyrone with W J Lee or Premier Princess could step forward dramatically having learned from their initial experience.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Totally Puzzled wires field
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace stays very slow and Totally Puzzled gets an easy lead
scenarios.body: Colin Keane can dictate terms from the front without pressure, reserving energy for a sustained kick. Her 177-day break may have freshened her up, and the step up to 1m2f could unlock improvement after her debut sixth.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapses into sprint
scenarios.trigger: If the early fractions are exceptionally slow creating a bunched finish
scenarios.body: The race becomes a dash from the 2f pole with positioning crucial in a cavalry charge. Horses with any tactical speed regardless of running style can capitalize, making this a lottery finish where traffic and luck determine the outcome.

races.paceDynamic: Faiyum, California Dreamer and Moments Of Joy will ensure a strong gallop from the start, with three confirmed front runners guaranteeing a genuine pace over this mile trip on testing ground. The prominent congestion behind them creates tactical complications, as She's A Nation, Bubble Gum, Celestial Orbit, Cameo and Spicy Margarita all want similar positions, setting up potential traffic problems turning for home. The combination of honest early pace and soft going will stretch the field out significantly in the final two furlongs. This setup strongly favours hold-up horses and those with proven stamina reserves — the genuine gallop will expose the front runners and allow closers to pick up the pieces.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is genuinely strong and the soft ground takes its toll on the leaders.
scenarios.body: The three front runners will burn each other out in the testing conditions, while the prominent runners get caught in traffic. Late-running types with stamina will have clear runs to mow down tired leaders in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent position perfect
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners can secure the ideal spot just behind the pace without getting trapped.
scenarios.body: They avoid the early speed battle but stay close enough to strike when the leaders weaken, benefiting from both the strong pace and avoiding late traffic. The soft ground aids their stamina-laden profiles.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front runner survives
scenarios.trigger: If one pace-setter gets an easy lead while the other two are pressured or make mistakes.
scenarios.body: A lone leader can control the fractions and have enough left to hold off the closers, especially if the ground doesn't play as testing as expected. Class tells in the finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical chaos benefits outsider
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses early or severe traffic problems develop in the straight.
scenarios.body: The well-fancied runners are compromised by positioning or pace issues, allowing a horse with the right trip to emerge from the pack. An unfancied runner gets the perfect run through.

watchPoints.text: Watch California Dreamer's early positioning as her poor soft going record combined with front-running style could see her fade dramatically if pressed hard early.
Monitor the prominent runners She's A Nation, Bubble Gum, Celestial Orbit and Spicy Margarita for traffic problems as four horses wanting similar positions creates congestion risk.

Keep an eye on Faiyum's response to pace pressure as she's proven when getting her own way in front but may struggle if harassed early by California Dreamer.

races.paceDynamic: With only Dar Toungi showing clear front-running intent among 21 runners, this shapes as a moderate pace scenario where the lone leader won't face early pressure. The large field of predominantly prominent and hold-up horses means most will be held up early, creating a bunched field tracking Dar Toungi through steady fractions. The real race begins when the field fans out in the straight, with positioning crucial on the Curragh's wide home turn. This setup moderately favours prominent racers who can secure good positions behind the leader without being too far back in such a large field.

scenarios.label: A

races.paceDynamic: Norwalk Havoc is the sole confirmed front-runner and will dictate proceedings from the start, with Eastwatch, Glen To Glen, Dutch Gold and Chica Guerrera likely to track in prominent positions. With only one natural leader in a 20-runner field, Norwalk Havoc can control the tempo without early pressure, setting a sustainable gallop that will allow the field to bunch up entering the final three furlongs. The large field of 16 hold-up horses will be forced to come from off the pace on soft ground that can blunt finishing kicks. This setup strongly favours prominent runners and those that can get into good early positions — the controlled pace means leaders won't stop and the soft going will make it difficult for horses coming from the rear.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Norwalk Havoc gets an uncontested lead and controls fractions perfectly
scenarios.body: Shane Foley can dictate every call from the front, slowing the pace when needed and having plenty left for the finish on ground that suits. The 16 hold-up horses will struggle to make up ground from off such a controlled pace.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Battle
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners apply early pressure to Norwalk Havoc and create a stronger gallop
scenarios.body: Eastwatch, Glen To Glen and Dutch Gold engage the leader earlier than ideal, setting up a tactical battle in the final quarter-mile where class and RPR ratings become decisive. This creates opportunities for the better hold-up horses with high RPRs.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-up Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely in the middle stages and becomes stop-start
scenarios.body: The soft ground won't be as much of a hindrance with such a slow tempo, allowing the classy hold-up horses like Coeur d'Or (RPR 108) and Akecheta to unleash devastating finishing kicks. The prominent runners get caught napping.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Meltdown Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If Norwalk Havoc goes too fast early under pressure from multiple prominent runners
scenarios.body: The entire field comes back to the leaders in the final two furlongs as they all tire on the testing ground. This creates a cavalry charge finish where any horse getting the right run can win.
